description: Operational truth from PostgreSQL ingestion metadata, including BCB macro runs and latest snapshot state. Empty panels mean no collector run has been registered; SEC remains ingestion-only.

panels.description: Failures and partial runs in the selected interval.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::double precision AS value FROM ingestion_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND status IN ('failed', 'partial')

panels.title: Failed / partial runs

panels.description: Records explicitly rejected by validation in the selected interval.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(records_rejected), 0)::double precision AS value FROM ingestion_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Rejected records

panels.description: Source freshness is based on successful run completion, not source-observation freshness. A successful rerun with records_written = 0 is an expected idempotent no-change result.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ds.code AS source, max(ir.finished_at) FILTER (WHERE ir.status = 'succeeded') AS last_success, round((extract(epoch FROM now() - max(ir.finished_at) FILTER (WHERE ir.status = 'succeeded')) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS hours_since_success FROM data_sources ds LEFT JOIN ingestion_runs ir ON ir.data_source_id = ds.id GROUP BY ds.code ORDER BY ds.code

panels.title: Collector freshness

targets.rawSql: SELECT ir.started_at, ir.finished_at, ds.code AS source, ir.status::text, ir.records_received, ir.records_written, ir.records_rejected, ir.raw_payload_count, ir.error_message FROM ingestion_runs ir JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.id = ir.data_source_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ir.started_at) ORDER BY ir.started_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Latest operational snapshot state by configured source. BCB uses the macro snapshot projection. SEC remains ingestion-only because the projection schema defines no fundamental snapshot table; disabled sources and sources without a published snapshot remain explicit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ds.code AS source, ds.enabled, CASE ds.source_kind WHEN 'market_data' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM market_price_snapshots p WHERE p.data_source_id = ds.id) WHEN 'macro' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM macro_observation_snapshots m WHERE m.data_source_id = ds.id) ELSE NULL END AS snapshot_rows, CASE WHEN ds.code = 'sec' THEN 'ingestion only' WHEN NOT ds.enabled THEN 'source disabled' WHEN ds.source_kind IN ('market_data', 'macro') AND CASE ds.source_kind WHEN 'market_data' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM market_price_snapshots p WHERE p.data_source_id = ds.id) WHEN 'macro' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM macro_observation_snapshots m WHERE m.data_source_id = ds.id) ELSE false END THEN 'published' ELSE 'no snapshot published' END AS snapshot_state FROM data_sources ds WHERE ds.code = 'sec' OR ds.source_kind IN ('market_data', 'macro') ORDER BY ds.code

panels.title: Latest snapshot state
